Only `FractionAgentTest.java` was added; the pre-existing deletion of `FractionTest.java` is untouched, as required.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/FractionAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (matching the project's style: `org.junit.jupiter.api.Test` + static `Assertions` imports, no shared base class) with 95 test methods covering `Fraction`'s full public API:

- All 12 static constants (`ZERO`, `ONE`, `ONE_HALF`, … `FOUR_FIFTHS`)
- Factory methods `getFraction(double|int,int|int,int,int|String)` and `getReducedFraction`, including boundary/error cases: NaN, infinity, overflow near `Integer.MAX_VALUE`/`MIN_VALUE`, zero/negative denominators, malformed strings, and `null` input
- Arithmetic (`add`, `subtract`, `multiplyBy`, `divideBy`, `pow`, `invert`, `negate`, `abs`, `reduce`) including identity cases (return-same-instance checks), zero handling, and overflow `ArithmeticException`s
- `compareTo`, `equals`, `hashCode` (including the documented equals/compareTo inconsistency for unreduced fractions)
- `doubleValue`, `floatValue`, `intValue`, `longValue`, `getNumerator`, `getDenominator`, `getProperNumerator`, `getProperWhole`
- `toString` / `toProperString` formatting across proper, improper, negative, whole-number, and zero cases

Verified with `mvn test -Dtest=FractionAgentTest`: **95/95 passing**, build success.
